# GlassesLayout

`GlassesLayout` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `layout:clearAndDisplay()`.

## Obtained from

- [`glasses.createLayout()`](../../glasses/createLayout.md)

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`clearAndDisplay()`](clearAndDisplay.md) | Clear layout and display text. | 26.1.0 |
| [`clearAndDisplayExtended()`](clearAndDisplayExtended.md) | Clear layout and display text at position x, y with optional extra commands. | 26.1.0 |
